name: pin
title: The pinch pin: a snap pin whose foot clamps a cartridge's floor to the frame
orientation: Standing on its foot, as the generator draws it. Pushed from inside a cartridge through the hole in its floor into the frame's socket: the barb clicks out in the socket's cavity, the foot pinches the floor to the frame. Print one per hole.

diameter.rule: The pin's diameter, the cartridges' and the frame's holes less a fit

length.rule: The shaft: through a cartridge's floor and the frame's cavity wall, so the barb clicks out beyond

slot.rule: The split down the pin from its tip: through the barb and most of the shaft

head.rule: The foot past the shaft all round
